title: Project Quality Engineer
description:
Hiring: Project Quality Engineer

Location: Sanand, Gujarat, India

Industry: Automotive Manufacturing

Department: Quality / New Product Development

Reporting to: Project Manager(s)

Experience: 3–6 years (automotive manufacturing preferred)

About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented Project Quality Engineer to manage quality planning and execution throughout the project lifecycle, from new product development and customer approval to production launch and final handover. The role will work closely with Project Managers and cross-functional teams to ensure product quality, compliance with customer-specific requirements, timely completion of quality deliverables, and readiness for mass production.

Key Responsibilities

1. Project Quality Planning

\* Develop and maintain project-specific quality plans, inspection plans, and quality deliverables in line with customer requirements.

\* Prepare and coordinate APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) activities and maintain project quality milestones.

\* Coordinate the preparation and review of PFMEA, DFMEA inputs, Process Flow Diagrams, Control Plans, and Process Capability studies.

\* Ensure compliance with IATF 16949, ISO 9001, customer-specific requirements, and applicable automotive quality standards.

\* Identify project quality risks and coordinate preventive actions with relevant stakeholders.

2. New Product Development & Launch

\* Coordinate quality activities from prototype and sample development through validation, customer approval, and mass-production launch.

\* Plan and monitor prototype, pre-launch, and production-stage inspections and testing.

\* Coordinate PPAP (Production Part Approval Process) documentation and submission, including dimensional reports, material and performance test reports, MSA, SPC, and other applicable requirements.

\* Ensure timely closure of customer observations and approval-related open points.

\* Verify process readiness and quality documentation before production handover.

3. Cross-Functional Project Coordination

\* Work closely with Project Managers, Production, Process Engineering, Design/R&D, Supplier Quality, Purchase, and Customer Quality teams.

\* Track quality-related project milestones, deliverables, risks, and pending actions.

\* Participate in project review meetings and provide updates on quality status, delays, risks, and corrective actions.

\* Coordinate trial runs, pilot production, engineering changes, and validation activities.

\* Ensure changes to drawings, specifications, materials, processes, and tooling are assessed, approved, and documented before implementation.

4. Problem Solving & Corrective Actions

\* Lead or coordinate root-cause analysis for project-related defects and launch issues using 5 Why, Fishbone, 8D, and other structured problem-solving methods.

\* Monitor containment, corrective, and preventive actions and verify their effectiveness.

\* Coordinate resolution of dimensional, material, functional, and process-related quality issues.

\* Maintain a lessons-learned register and ensure recurring issues are prevented in subsequent projects.

5. Supplier & Customer Quality Coordination

\* Coordinate with Supplier Quality and suppliers on new component development, supplier PPAP, sample approval, and supplier-related project issues.

\* Support customer audits, process audits, product audits, and quality reviews as required.

\* Ensure customer-specific quality documentation and approval requirements are completed on time.

\* Facilitate timely closure of customer complaints or concerns associated with new launches and project changes.

6. Production Readiness & Documentation

\* Verify availability and completeness of inspection standards, Control Plans, work instructions, gauges, measuring equipment, and quality records before launch.

\* Monitor trial production results, first-off inspections, dimensional conformity, and process capability.

\* Ensure measurement systems are validated and inspection equipment is calibrated.

\* Maintain traceability of samples, inspection results, approvals, deviations, and engineering changes.

\* Support safe and controlled transition from project development to regular production.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

\* On-time completion of project quality milestones and deliverables.

\* On-time PPAP submission and customer approval.

\* First-pass yield and right-first-time performance during trials and launch.

\* Number and severity of launch-related defects and customer complaints.

\* Timely closure and effectiveness of corrective and preventive actions.

\* Compliance with APQP, Control Plan, PFMEA, and other required quality documentation.

\* Supplier quality approval and incoming quality performance for new projects.

\* Reduction in repeat defects, rework, and scrap attributable to project or launch issues.

\* Audit findings and timely closure of non-conformities.

\* Production handover completed with all mandatory quality approvals and documentation.

Required Qualifications & Skills

\* Bachelor’s degree or Diploma in Mechanical, Production, Automobile, or a related engineering discipline.

\* 3–6 years of experience in quality engineering within automotive or precision manufacturing.

\* Working knowledge of APQP, PPAP, PFMEA, Control Plans, MSA, SPC, 8D, and root-cause analysis.

\* Familiarity with IATF 16949, ISO 9001, and customer-specific requirements.

\* Experience with dimensional inspection, engineering drawings, GD&T, and measuring instruments.

\* Ability to coordinate cross-functional teams and manage multiple project deliverables.

\* Strong analytical, documentation, communication, and problem-solving skills.

\* Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and quality documentation systems.

Preferred Experience

\* Experience in automotive OEM or Tier-1 manufacturing environments.

\* Exposure to new product development, process validation, pilot runs, and mass-production launches.

\* Experience with metal components, formed or fabricated parts, machining, wheel/rim assemblies, or similar automotive products.

\* Knowledge of customer approval systems and automotive core tools.

Interested candidates: Apply through LinkedIn with an updated resume highlighting relevant automotive project quality, APQP/PPAP, and product-launch experience.

title: Consultant / Sr. Consultant - Energy Transition & Sustainability Strategy
description:
**About Pravi**

Pravi is a strategy and policy consulting firm that helps governments, institutions and businesses move from intent to implementation. Our work spans strategy, policy design, digital transformation and data-led decision-making, with a focus on outcomes that can be measured on the ground.

**Why this Role**

India is in the middle of one of the largest energy transitions in the world. Decisions being taken now on storage, renewables, energy efficiency, clean fuels and carbon markets will shape how the country produces and uses energy for decades. You will help shape policies, programmes and implement them in renewable energy, energy storage, energy efficiency, carbon markets and clean fuels. You will assist in research of what works, support decisions, set up the systems that put those decisions into action, and work directly with senior officials and industry leaders.

**Key focus areas**

* Energy efficiency and conservation: BEE programmes and their implementation, including PAT, CCTS, ECBC, Standards and Labelling, and Demand Side Management
* Renewable and alternative energy: Solar, wind and hybrid systems, grid integration and power system fundamentals, renewable purchase and consumption obligations (RPO/RCO)
* Energy storage: Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) and other storage technologies ○ Carbon markets and decarbonisation: carbon credit mechanisms, MRV, climate mitigation interventions and decarbonisation pathways
* Biogas and alternative fuels: Compressed Biogas (CBG), associated technologies and other clean fuels
* Waste and circular economy: waste management, and recycling and circular management of renewable energy equipment
* Climate change and emerging areas: sectoral implications of climate change, clean technologies and other emerging areas in the energy transition

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Research and Policy Assistance

* Undertake research and analysis across the focus areas to support decision-making
* Review existing policies and programmes to identify gaps requiring policy, regulatory or implementation interventions
* Draft issue notes, analytical briefs, policy documents, technical studies, background material and presentations
* Examine documents and matters requiring technical inputs, and prepare technical notes, comments and responses

2. Programme Design, Implementation and Management

* Translate climate and energy priorities into actionable plans, and support them through preparation, review and implementation
* Support the roll-out of policies, programmes and facilitation services, from design to day-to-day operations
* Support the setup, staffing and operation of dedicated cells of work areas, including RPO/RCO mechanisms and carbon credit facilitation
* Support the implementation of BEE schemes and initiatives under the Energy Conservation Act, 2001
* Assist in Demand Side Management programmes, management of energy conservation funds, PAT/CCTS processes and monitoring of renewable consumption obligations
* Monitor programme progress, consolidate information, and follow up on activities and action points
* Prepare periodic reports and submissions in prescribed formats and timelines
* Help conceptualise, develop, integrate and manage digital portals and platforms

3. Stakeholder Engagement and Coordination

* Coordinate with government departments, central ministries and agencies, industry associations, developers, manufacturers, financial institutions, international organisations, universities, research bodies and knowledge partners
* Manage meetings and consultations end to end: agendas, presentations, invitations, background material and data collection formats
* Record discussions, prepare Minutes of Meeting and track follow-up actions

4. Capacity Building and Knowledge Management

* Develop learning resources such as reference materials, knowledge toolkits, training content and print material, tailored to the stakeholder needs
* Plan and conduct training programmes, workshops and other learning sessions for stakeholders

**Required experience and skills**

● 4 to 10 years of experience in energy, power, climate, renewable, policy research, CSR or consulting sector

● Working knowledge of at least two of the focus areas listed above

● Understanding of power systems and renewable energy fundamentals

● Familiarity with BEE norms and energy efficiency programmes

● Strong research, analytical and report-writing skills

● Good presentation skills and proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint / Canva

● Experience engaging with senior stakeholders in government, industry or institutions

**Good to have**

● Experience with consulting firms, development organisations, think tanks, research institutions, or energy and sustainability companies

● BEE Certified Energy Auditor or Energy Manager certification

● Exposure to carbon markets, CBG or BESS projects

● Experience designing or managing CSR programmes

● Proficiency in Gujarati Language

**Who we are looking for**

You will do well in this role if you:

● Enjoy building a deep understanding of a subject and can explain it simply to others

● Structure your thinking before you write or speak, and communicate it clearly

● Question assumptions, including your own, and form views backed by evidence

● Are comfortable presenting to senior stakeholders and standing by your recommendations

● Take full ownership of your work, from the first draft to final delivery

● Are eager to learn new domains and stay confident when the path is not clearly defined

What can you expect from this role?

● Work on live energy transition projects with real implementation outcomes

● Direct exposure to senior decision-makers from early in your career

● Ownership of deliverables, not just support tasks

● Learning across multiple domains in a single versatile role

● A team where good work is always noticed and rewarded

title: Project Engineer–Commercial Solar Projects
description:
**Role Summary**

Ample Solar is looking for a Project Engineer to take ownership of the execution of commercial and industrial solar projects from post sales handover through planning, installation, testing, and commissioning.

The role involves close coordination with engineering, procurement, dispatch, installation, electrical and customer teams to ensure that projects are executed systematically, within the committed schedule, and as per the required quality standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Take ownership of end to end execution of commercial solar projects from sales handover to commissioning.
* Develop project execution schedules covering engineering, material readiness, dispatch, site installation, electrical works, testing and commissioning.
* Coordinate with Design, Liaisoning team, Procurement, Stores, Dispatch and Installation teams to ensure timely availability of resources and materials.
* Plan and coordinate deployment of installation teams based on project requirements and execution schedules.
* Monitor project progress against planned milestones and ensure timely completion of activities.
* Identify project constraints, site issues, and potential delays in advance and take appropriate corrective actions.
* Coordinate with customers, site representatives, vendors, and contractors for smooth project execution.
* Ensure execution is carried out in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, safety and quality requirements.
* Coordinate testing, commissioning, statutory/DISCOM activities wherever applicable, and final project handover.
* Maintain project status, execution records, and timely reporting to the management.

**Candidate Profile**

* 3–4 years of experience in Solar EPC/Project Execution, preferably handling commercial or industrial rooftop projects.
* Strong understanding of solar PV systems, electrical installation, and project execution.
* Experience in coordinating installation teams, contractors, vendors and multiple internal departments.
* Good knowledge of project planning, material coordination, and site execution.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and work towards strict project timelines.
* Strong communication, coordination, follow-up, and problem solving skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and project tracking/reporting tools will be an advantage.

**Key Requirement**

The ideal candidate should have a strong project ownership mindset, capable of planning the execution well in advance, coordinating all required resources and taking timely action to ensure that commercial solar projects are completed as committed, without avoidable delays.

**Compensation & Career Growth Opportunities:**

* The candidate will be offered a competitive cost to company (CTC) along with performance based incentives linked to the timely implementation of assigned projects and other governing parameters
* Company believes in company growth along with their employee growth, Strong opportunities for professional growth, career advancement, and long term leadership development.
* We rise together: your personal development fuels our corporate expansion in the solar industry.

**Company Overview:**

Ample Solar Private Limited is a Gujarat based solar company delivering scalable renewable energy solutions from rooftop systems, ground mounted solar projects to multi megawatt industrial solar projects. The company serves residential customers, MSMEs, and large industries with a strong focus on engineering quality and execution excellence.

With 3000+ operations completed and demonstrated capability in MW scale project execution, Ample Solar supports large industrial clients in achieving energy cost optimization and sustainability targets. Backed as an authorized Tata Group channel partner, the company brings good quality components, structured processes, and reliable delivery across all project sizes. Ample Solar is also entered a phase of strategic multi state expansion, strengthening its presence in key industrial corridors to support India’s clean energy transition.
